description: Get one message by id: sender, recipients, subject, extracted_text (the new content, without quoted history/signature), detected verification code/link (ai.verification), attachment metadata and labels.

include_full_text.description: Also return the full plain text including quoted history (default false).

include_html.description: Also return the raw HTML body (default false; rarely needed).

mark_read.description: Also mark the received messages read (default false: reading stays read-only).

name: get_message
title: Get message
